name: Nike Barcelona Kids Pre-Match Dri-Fit Strike

description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike pre-match warm-up sweatshirt for children 2026 2027 - burgundy
description.tagline: Prepare for the match like FC Barcelona
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Pre-Match Dri-Fit Strike children's sweatshirt is designed to accompany young footballers during warm-ups and training with the identity of the Blaugrana team. Its design incorporates a graphic print inspired by the FC Barcelona third kit, while its fitted cut favors freedom of movement. Thanks to Nike Dri-FIT technology, it helps keep you feeling cool and comfortable during activity, allowing you to focus on each exercise.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Helps wick away sweat and keep skin dry.
Pre-Match Design: Inspired by the garment that players wear before the match.
Light and breathable fabric: Promotes comfort and freedom of movement.
Thumbholes: Keep sleeves in place and provide added coverage.
FC Barcelona Design: Print inspired by the FCB third kit.

Su diseño incorpora un estampado gráfico inspirado en la tercera equipación del FC Barcelona, mientras que su corte entallado favorece la libertad de movimiento. Gracias a la tecnología Nike Dri-FIT, ayuda a mantener una sensación fresca y cómoda durante la actividad, permitiendo concentrarse en cada ejercicio.
key_benefits: Tecnología Nike Dri-FIT: Ayuda a evacuar el sudor y mantener la piel seca.
Diseño Pre-Match: Inspirado en la prenda que usan los jugadores antes del partido.
Tejido ligero y transpirable: Favorece la comodidad y la libertad de movimiento.
Orificios para los pulgares: Mantienen las mangas en su sitio y aportan mayor cobertura.
